The current best score is 1.1429, which corresponds to a rank of 28 (since score = seed/rank, and seed is likely 32, $32/28 \approx 1.1429$). The schoolbook algorithm has rank $2 \times 2 \times 8 = 32$.

The matrix multiplication tensor for $M_{2,2,8}$ can be viewed as a block structure. The input $A$ is $2 \times 2$, $B$ is $2 \times 8$, and the output $C$ is $2 \times 8$.
Let $A = \begin{pmatrix} a_{00} & a_{01} \\ a_{10} & a_{11} \end{pmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{pmatrix} b_{00} & \dots & b_{07} \\ b_{10} & \dots & b_{17} \end{pmatrix}$.
The output $C = A B$ has entries $c_{ij} = \sum_{k=0}^1 a_{ik} b_{kj}$.
Specifically, for each column $j$ of $B$ (where $j=0,\dots,7$), the contribution to column $j$ of $C$ is $A \cdot \begin{pmatrix} b_{0j} \\ b_{1j} \end{pmatrix}$.
This means the tensor decomposes into 8 independent "slices" corresponding to each column of $B$, each being a $2 \times 2 \times 2$ matrix multiplication tensor (multiplying $2 \times 2$ by $2 \times 1$).
